history.source_selection: 35 original North Macedonia CSVs named by docs/data-audit/file-inventory.csv (SHA-256 and counts re-verified), plus gap years from the FIRMS area API clipped to the geoBoundaries 2016 polygon.
history.quality_policy: All rows exported unchanged in meaning; no confidence/type exclusion at export. Times are UTC from acq_date + zero-padded acq_time.

weather.credit: NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project, funded through the NASA Earth Science Applied Science Program; MERRA-2 reanalysis by NASA GMAO
weather.note: Daily means (wind components, speed, humidity), daily maximum (temperature, wind speed) and daily total (precipitation, bias-corrected), UTC days. Reanalysis about 50 km apart: regional weather, not station or valley-scale observations.
